scientific_integrity: Exact polynomial proof and explicit rational counterexample; numerical checks support, but do not prove, quantified assertions. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Only positive-area Euclidean parallelograms with independent area-uniform pairs and exact even moments; no claims for general quadrilaterals, finite-sample stability, or degenerating shapes. Earlier unpublished or inaccessible equivalent inverse criteria may exist.
title: Three even-distance moments give an exact and minimal inverse theorem for Euclidean parallelograms
